tool_calls.name: exec
tool_calls.input:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair-w61-cycle4.LV4cvA/validate.lua
+local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua"}
+local baseline = ".ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/baseline/"
+
+local function load_locale(path)
+	local records, current_section = {}, nil
+	_G.section = function(value) current_section = value end
+	_G.t = function(source, target, source_tag, args_order)
+		records[#records + 1] = {
+			section = current_section,
+			source = source,
+			target = target,
+			source_tag = source_tag,
+			args_order = args_order,
+		}
+	end
+	assert(loadfile(path))()
+	return records
+end
+
+local function args_equal(a, b)
+	if a == nil or b == nil then return a == b end
+	if #a ~= #b then return false end
+	for i = 1, #a do if a[i] ~= b[i] then return false end end
+	return true
+end
+
+local target_changes, args_changes = 0, 0
+local mutated_target
+for _, file in ipairs(files) do
+	local before = load_locale(baseline .. file)
+	local after = load_locale(file)
+	assert(#before == #after, file .. ": record count changed")
+	local file_targets, file_args = 0, 0
+	for i = 1, #before do
+		assert(before[i].section == after[i].section, file .. ": section changed at " .. i)
+		assert(before[i].source == after[i].source, file .. ": source changed at " .. i)
+		assert(before[i].source_tag == after[i].source_tag, file .. ": source_tag changed at " .. i)
+		if before[i].target ~= after[i].target then
+			target_changes, file_targets = target_changes + 1, file_targets + 1
+		end
+		if not args_equal(before[i].args_order, after[i].args_order) then
+			args_changes, file_args = args_changes + 1, file_args + 1
+		end
+		if after[i].source:find("Your tentacle hand currently has these stats", 1, true) then
+			mutated_target = after[i].target
+		end
+	end
+	print(string.format("LOAD_OK %s records=%d target_changes=%d args_order_changes=%d", file, #after, file_targets, file_args))
+end
+assert(target_changes == 22, "expected 22 target changes, got " .. target_changes)
+assert(args_changes == 4, "expected 4 args_order changes, got " .. args_changes)
+print(string.format("BASELINE_OK target_changes=%d args_order_changes=%d", target_changes, args_changes))
+
+assert(mutated_target, "Mutated Hand target not found")
+local function last_two(rendered)
+	local a, b = rendered:match("([^\n]*)\n([^\n]*)$")
+	assert(a and b, "could not extract final two lines")
+	return a, b
+end
+for label, suffix in pairs({empty = "", disabled = "，#CRIMSON#由于副手非空，该技能暂时被禁用#WHITE#"}) do
+	local rendered = string.format(mutated_target, 11, 22, 33, suffix, "触手数据")
+	local a, b = last_two(rendered)
+	print("FORMAT_" .. label:upper() .. " " .. a)
+	print("FORMAT_" .. label:upper() .. " " .. b)
+end
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
